Perfect Treasure Map (Korean: 완벽한 보물지도, wanbyeoghan bomuljido) is an Epic Treasure released alongside Kumiho Cookie's Magic Candy during the Black Sugar Pirate Ship update. It spawns Map Fragment Jellies and creates Treasure Chests for every seven of them.

Story

An unknown Cookie has searched high and low for the fragments of this map. Now that it's complete, it will help you find a treasure!

Skill

Perfect Treasure Map's Skill
Map Fragment Jellies appear at regular intervals. Collect enough Map Fragment Jellies to discover a hidden chest filled with Map Fragment Jellies, various Gem Jellies, and items. Level Up for more points for Gem Jellies found in the chest.
Level Skill
1 Map Fragment Jellies appear every 3.2 sec
Collect 7 Map Fragment Jellies to discover a treasure chest
+115,000 points for Map Fragment Jellies
+25,100 points for Treasure Jellies
+2 Energy recovered by Life Treasure Jellies
12 Map Fragment Jellies appear every 3.2 sec
Collect 7 Map Fragment Jellies to discover a treasure chest
+115,000 points for Map Fragment Jellies
+200,000 points for Treasure Jellies
+2 Energy recovered by Life Treasure Jellies
Enhanced Effect
Level Skill
6 +85,000 points for Map Fragment Jellies

Gameplay Notes

  • Items that spawn from the chests are in the following sequence:
    • 3 Map Fragment Jellies → Treasure Coins → Treasure Jellies → Giant Blast Jelly (with the texture of a normal Blast Jelly) → 3 Map Fragment Jellies → Treasure Coins → Life Treasure Jellies (which restore Energy) → Treasure Jellies

Changelog

  • The Treasure of Legends - June 14, 2022
    • Combi Bonus added with Cauliflower Cookie.
    • Life Treasure Jellies now have their points increased the same as regular Treasure Jellies.
    • Points for Yellow and Red Treasure Jellies slightly decreased.
    • Points for Map Fragment Jellies increased.
    • Points for Treasure Jellies increased.
  • The Witch's Mystic Attic - January 27, 2022
    • Combi Bonus added with Chili Pepper Cookie.
  • Martial Arts Champion - May 28, 2020
    • Treasure Jellies from chests will no longer be clumped to overlap entirely.
    • Items appearing from chests will now spawn at a fixed distance.
  • Dreamy CookieLand - May 9, 2020
    • Treasure Jellies from chests clump to overlap.*

Trivia

  • Oddly, unless in the small rolled-up part of the map, the dotted lines on the map meant to lead to a treasure seem to lead to nothing.
  • Though Perfect Treasure Map is implied to be split up into pieces due to how its ability works and its description, there are no signs that it has been torn up into many pieces and then put back together again aside from a few small tears on the sides.
  • Perfect Treasure Map appears in a cutscene for The Treasure and the Crow story.
